LanguageData.Bamba_Melee_Quasar_Longsword.label: kwazaari sword
LanguageData.Bamba_Melee_Quasar_Longsword.description: A sword forged from Quasar Alloy and sharpened within a molecule of width, a somewhat mundane yet occasionally useful weapon in Kwaazari society.
LanguageData.Bamba_Melee_Quasar_Axe.label: kwazaari axe
LanguageData.Bamba_Melee_Quasar_Axe.description: An axe forged from Quasar Alloy, its edge honed to a molecule of width. Favors a decisive cutting stroke over the blunt trauma of its hammer cousin. Not manufactured by any known bench - salvaged or issued only.
